summary: Simplify existing LFL Web Provider settings, make failed or unconfirmed API Key saves explicit, and advance the Deepin immutable-wheel candidate version from 0.6.57 to 0.6.58 without changing release authorization machinery.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing Web V2 ProviderManager, provider-admin API, credential persistence, model connection probe and immutable Linux wheel version identity; existing Web authentication, Origin/CSRF, Provider config version, service reload and installer CAS remain authoritative.
components.disposition: Move API Key entry to the Provider card and use the existing credential-only PUT endpoint. Keep the input visible on failure and on successful PUT followed by unconfirmed state reload; display an explicit uncertainty message rather than a false success. Render provider and model editors locally, collapse advanced settings, and give reasoning-capable model probes a bounded 256-token output budget instead of 8. Bump the consistent package/lock/Web service/README/Changelog candidate version to 0.6.58 because the Linux installer refuses to overwrite a retained 0.6.57 wheel with different bytes; preserve 0.6.57 for rollback.
evidence: Deepin 25 live LFL v0.6.57 on 2026-11-23: /health HTTP 200, GLM provider lists glm-5.4 and glm-5.3-flash but credential_configured=false and credential_source=missing. Existing live Web bundle lacks the new direct API Key action.

Original code-only SHA 706ac87f95d611a970214ca0e5c3519f5bdb0b0f passed the original complete ci_gate.sh --release exit 0: WebUI 624 tests and pytest 16542 passed / 162 skipped / 3 xfailed; Ruff and Pyright passed.

Independent read-only DeepSeek Flash reviewer identified the real post-write status-read failure edge case. Follow-up code-only SHA b058a84707fe2e2006297ba251eb6156c5517fba adds an explicit unconfirmed-save path and a deterministic regression; focused ProviderManager Vitest 21 passed and TypeScript noEmit passed.

Independent read-only reviewer on b058a84707fe2e2006297ba251eb6156c5517fba returned PASS, P0=0, P1=0, P2=2, observed model deepseek-flash, finish_reason stop; local evidence /tmp/lfl-pr104-independent-review-b058a847.json. The manifest-inclusive final SHA requires new review and full R9.

Deepin currently retains immutable LFL-0.6.57 and previous LFL-0.6.56 release directories; the installer rejects a different wheel with the same 0.6.57 version. A 0.6.58 identity is therefore required before production staging.

The existing PR #104 was initially Draft; the new version-inclusive candidate requires exact-SHA independent review, full R9, remote PR CI, protected merge, Linux installer and actual Deepin host testing before any production success claim.
components.verification_level: Code-only candidate has independent PASS and targeted regression tests. Final version-inclusive candidate must pass exact-SHA independent review, original full R9, remote PR CI, protected merge and main CI before the 0.6.58 Deepin wheel is installed.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: A failed or unconfirmed credential write must not be reported as saved; do not expose key bytes in responses or UI text. Preserve Provider config version conflict feedback, existing model defaults, read-only mode, auth and CSRF. On physical host failure, retain the previous release and rollback pointer; no forced service restart while a Run is active.
components.rollback_route: Revert the bounded Web Provider settings change through a protected PR and use the existing Deepin Linux installer --rollback to the retained prior version if a later managed deployment fails; do not overwrite user .env or unrelated active sessions.
